title: Report rides the herding mailbox and the detach fact becomes a flag
action: Per plan Approach 1-2 (rev 2). mailbox.rs: contract template gains the report instruction — write the full deliverable to report-{round}.md FIRST (atomic temp+rename), result JSON LAST; a resumed attempt REWRITES the report before its result; result JSON gains optional report_path. MailboxResult gains report_path and the resolved round; parse stays tolerant (legacy result with no field and no file = legal, envelope unchanged byte-for-byte). run.rs read_result: resolve the report at parse time — worker-declared path wins; else convention probe accepts report-{round}.md only when fresh (mtime >= the round brief/ack delivery time), stale = report_note; Malformed arm surfaces an existing report path beside the error. Envelope: report_path/report_note added ONLY when present — EXTEND the exact-key test family at run.rs:5133 with additive rows, never loosen it (no-new-key law, the-run-verb-and-worker-outcomes.md:211). New flag --inbox-session <token>: presence = detached fact; marker .bee/result-inbox/<token>/<job-id>.json (atomic; job id, mailbox path, cell id) written BEFORE the pane spawns; no flag = no marker; empty/unresolvable token = no marker + stderr note. Unit tests per the plan matrix Contract/Freshness/Delivery rows.

truths: legacy result with no report yields an envelope byte-identical to today
stale same-round report becomes report_note, never a silent attach
--inbox-session writes the marker before spawn; absent flag writes none
malformed result with a good report surfaces both error and report_path

artifacts.substantive: report resolution at parse site, additive envelope keys, --inbox-session marker path

key_links: result_envelope stays a pure builder; report resolves in read_result
prohibitions: No inline report body in the run output at any size
No exactly-once claim in code or test names
